# Using Disk Cleanup in OpenCode

<!-- Generated by `node packages/cli build` from the harness registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

The skill is the same in every agent. This guide covers only what is specific to OpenCode.

## Install

Project scope (one repository): copy this skill folder to `.opencode/skills/disk-cleanup/`.

User scope (every project): copy it to `~/.config/opencode/skills/disk-cleanup/`.

From the gti-skills repository, the CLI does the copy for you:

```bash
node packages/cli install --harness opencode --skill disk-cleanup
node packages/cli install --harness opencode --skill disk-cleanup --scope user
```

Restart the agent session after installing so it rescans its skills.

## Use

Describe the task in plain language. OpenCode loads the skill when the request matches its `description`. You can also name it in the request, for example: "Use the disk-cleanup skill to ...".

## Where the skill finds its files

`<skill-dir>` in `SKILL.md` is the folder that contains `SKILL.md`: `.opencode/skills/disk-cleanup` for a project install, or `~/.config/opencode/skills/disk-cleanup` for a user install. Scripts and references are always addressed relative to it.

## Verify

Ask the agent which skills it has loaded and check that `disk-cleanup` is listed.

## Notes

- OpenCode also reads .claude/skills and .agents/skills.
- Disk Cleanup needs Python 3.8+ and runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS; run the agent's terminal as Administrator or under your own sudo only if you want admin-only items cleaned.
- Documentation: [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/docs/skills/) (path source: official).
